instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create a Verilog module that implements an LCD driver. 
An LCD driver is a type of digital circuit that drives an LCD (liquid crystal display). 
The inputs to the circuit are connected to a set of data lines, and the outputs are connected to a set of control lines. 
The control lines are used to control the operation of the LCD, such as selecting the display mode or turning on and off the display.
Your module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of n data signals (data1, data2, ..., datan)
Outputs: a set of m control signals (ctrl1, ctrl2, ..., ctrlm)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the number of data signals
m: the number of control signals
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The circuit should be able to write data to the LCD.
The circuit should be able to read data from the LCD.
The circuit should be able to control the operation of the LCD, such as selecting the display mode or turning on and off the display.
To implement the LCD driver, you should use Verilog code to define the control signals as Boolean functions of the input signals. 
You should then use these functions to connect the inputs to the control lines and control the operation of the LCD. 
You should also use the data signals to write data to the LCD and read data from the LCD.
